I have recently become a big fan of the WoT series. 

As of September 2008 I have only made it half way through [[A Crown of Swords]]. Since the entire scope of the narrative is so rich and detailed, I typically only make it through 1 or 2 chapters a day. At that rate I should be done with [[Knife of Dreams]] sometime into the New Year. *grin*.

My favorite book so far has been [[The Fires of Heaven]]. My only regret being that [[Asmodean]] was killed off too soon.

I am crossing my fingers that [[A Memory of Light]] will live up to Jordan's work.
